questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the given sets.

(NOTE : Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13- Operations on 13 such as adding /Subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is NOT allowed)

(194, 14, 4)

(527, 23, 5)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :- 

**​(Second number)² - 2 = First Number**

**(Third Number)² - 2 = Second Number**

(194, 14, 4) → (14)² - 2 = 194

4² - 2 = 14

and

(527, 23, 5) → (23)² - 2 = 527

5² - 2 = 23

Similarly,

**(2, 2, 2) → (2)²​ - 2 = 2**

**2² - 2 = 2**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(2, 2, 2)".**

questions.question:
Which of the following interchange of numbers and signs would make the given equation correct?

24 × 9 + 6 ÷ 24 - 18 = 22
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/128af258e60f9ee332a9564df358d86b097e24c385dd68b3d6bd3d9b164fc234.png] 

**The given equation is 24 × 9 + 6 ÷ 24 - 18 = 22.**

Let's see which option makes this equation correct:

**Option 1) 18 and 22, + and -**

Using this option, the equation becomes 24 × 9 - **6 ÷ 24** + 22 = 18.

** 24 × 9** - 0.25 + 22 = 18.

216 - 0.25 + 22 = 18.

237.75 ≠ 18

**Which is incorrect.**

**Option 2) 24 and 6, × and + **

By this option, the equation reads 6 + 9 × **24 ÷ 6** - 18 = 22. 

 6 + **9 ****× 4** - 18 = 22. 

6 + 36 - 18 = 22,

24 ≠ 22,

**Which is incorrect.**

Option 3) 6 and 9, ÷ and + 

Using this option, the equation becomes **24 × 6 ÷ 9** + 24 - 18 = 22.

16 + 24 - 18 = 22

40 - 18 = 22

**Which is correct.**

Option 4) 6 and 18, ÷ and × 

Using this option, the equation becomes 24 ÷ 9 + 18 × 24 - 6 = 22. 

2.67 + 432 - 6 = 22

428.67 ≠ 22,

Which is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer option 3.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are NOT related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(4, 5, 82)

(6, 11, 314)

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits.)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

(First number² + Second number²) × 2 = Third number

__
 
• (4, 5, 82) → (4² + 5²) × 2 = (16 + 25) × 2 = 41 × 2 = 82

and

 
• (6, 11, 314) → (6² + 11²) × 2 = (36 + 121) × 2 = 157 × 2 = 314

Similarly,

1) (7, 10, 298) → (7² + 10²) × 2 = (49 + 100) × 2 = 149 × 2 = 298

2) (13, 15, 788) → (13² + 15²) × 2 = (169 + 225) × 2 = 394 × 2 = 788

**3) (11, 9, 560) → (11² + 9²) × 2 = (121 + 81) × 2 = 202 × 2 = 404 ≠ 560**

4) (9, 8, 290) → (9² + 8²) × 2 = (81 + 64) × 2 = 145 × 2 = 290

∴ Here, '(11, 9, 560)' is **NOT related**__ in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

Hence, the correct answer is **"(11, 9, 560)".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **__Mistake Points__**

According to the question, "Which numbers are __**NOT related**__ in the same way as the numbers of the following sets"

Option 3 is not related to the given sets. So option 3 is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Which of the following interchanges of signs and numbers would make the given equation correct?

25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : × and +, 30 and 25

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 30 - 10 ÷ 5 × 15 + 25 = 55

⇒ 30 - __**10 ÷ 5**__ × 15 + 25 = 55

⇒ 30 - __**2 × 15**__ + 25 = 55

⇒ __**30**__ - 30 __**+ 25**__ = 55

⇒ __**55 - 30**__ = 55

⇒ 25 ≠ 55

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ÷ and +, 15 and 10

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 25 - 15 + 5 ÷ 10 × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 - 15 + __**5 ÷ 10**__ × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 - 15 + __**0.5 × 30**__ = 55

⇒ __**25**__ - 15 __**+ 15**__ = 55

⇒ __**40 - 15**__ = 55

⇒ 25 ≠ 55

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : × and -, 15 and 10

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 25 × 15 ÷ 5 + 10 - 30 = 55

⇒ 25 × __**15 ÷ 5**__ + 10 - 30 = 55

⇒ __**25 × 3**__ + 10 - 30 = 55

⇒ __**75 + 10**__ - 30 = 55

⇒ __**85 - 30**__ = 55

⇒ **55 = 55**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 4) : + and -, 5 and 10

Given equation is : 25 - 10 ÷ 5 + 15 × 30 = 55

After interchanging the two numbers and two signs the equation is as follows : 25 + 5 ÷ 10 - 15 × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 + __**5 ÷ 10**__ - 15 × 30 = 55

⇒ 25 + 0.5 - __**15 × 30**__ = 55

⇒ __**25 + 0.5**__ - 450 = 55

⇒ __**25.5 - 450**__ = 55

⇒ -424.5 ≠ 55

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"× and -, 15 and 10".**
